authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 11572 vāla explicitly gives Palula bōla/būla hair, Oriya bāḷa and WPah. bā. The survey bāl-/būl-/bā forms fit this hair family, with any regional transmission retained as uncertain. Exact survey form baḷə is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
